visual.name: plumeHeatmap
visual.description: Heatmap with the Plume Studio look: grid (rows x columns), calendar heatmap (one or several years, weeks or months, GitHub style) and day-of-week x hour heatmap computed from a date-time; single-hue or palette scales, equal classes; values in the cells with automatic text contrast; sort rows and columns by name, total or a column; premium animated play axis, diverging scale with an adjustable midpoint, quantiles, thresholds, square root and log scales, outliers ignored, % labels, margin totals and marginal bars, similarity ordering with dendrogram, public holidays and annotations, radial heatmap, proportional cell sizes, comparison with a reference and small multiples.
